title: Development of Digital Twin for Liquid Cooled Data Centers
text: The broader impact potential of this ICDS project is to develop and demonstrate a digital twin for liquid-cooled data centers.
note: Sponsored by The Penn State Institute for Computational and Data Sciences (2025-2026)

title: A Modelica-based Virtual Testbed for Hybrid-Cooled Data Centers
text: This project develops a Modelica-based virtual testbed for hybrid-cooled data centers, integrating air and liquid cooling systems to evaluate dynamic thermal interactions and optimize coordinated cooling control strategies.
note: Sponsored by The Penn State University Graduate Fellowship
